response.overview: This release captures GLAY DOME TOUR 2001-2002 'ONE LOVE', which traveled across Japan from late 2001 to early 2002. The footage features their final tour performance at Tokyo Dome on January 15th, 2002. This DVD is GLAY's first release to feature 5.1ch surround sound, allowing you to relive the powerful experience of the live concert.
response.title: GLAY DOME TOUR 2001-2002 ONE LOVE
